defs.def: an increase in an amount, a number or a level （数量或水平的）增加，提高

ex.s: The rising labor cost of building solar farms.
ex.t: 建设太阳能农场的人工成本上升。

ex.s: With gas prices rising and airport security lines snaking longer than ever, why not book your next domestic vacation on a train?
ex.t: 随着油价上涨和机场安检队伍排得前所未有的长，为什么不预订下一次国内旅行的火车票呢？

ex.s: Road accidents, which had fallen for years, are now rising sharply.
ex.t: 交通事故在连续多年下降后现在急剧上升。

ex.s: Michael Kelsey Paris, vice president of the Oklahoma Cattlemen's Association, said a robot could be extremely useful given rising concerns about cattle theft.
ex.t: 鉴于对偷牛行为日益增长的担忧，机器人可能非常有用。

ex.s: Cattle tend to be kept in remote places and their value has risen, making them appealing targets.
ex.t: 牛通常被养在偏远地区，其价值不断上升，使其成为诱人的目标。

ex.s: A rising trend of living in the UK.
ex.t: 英国的一种上升趋势。

ex.s: Since the 1930s, Mclntyre said, the biggest factors driving up water stress in the state have been rising temperatures, which cause trees to lose more water to the air, and earlier snowmelt, which reduces the water supply available to trees during the dry season.
ex.t: 麦金太尔说，自20世纪30年代以来，导致该州水压力上升的最大因素是气温上升——气温上升导致树木向空气中散失更多水分——以及融雪提前——融雪提前减少了旱季树木可用的供水量。

ex.s: And just like crypto currencies, there are those who think the islanders are smart to invest in this type of money, which is reported to have risen in value over the last three decades.
ex.t: 与加密货币一样，有些人认为岛民投资这类货币是明智的，据报道其在过去三十年里价值已经上升。

ex.s: Since I began thinking about this project in August 2011, the issue of sea-level rise and the need to place it historically have only become more urgent: between then and the end of 2022 the global sea rose by almost 5 centimeters, about half of the overall rise recorded by satellites since 1993.
ex.t: 自从2011年8月我开始思考这个项目以来，海平面上升问题以及将其置于历史背景中考察的必要性变得愈发紧迫：从那时到2022年底，全球海平面上升了近5厘米，约为卫星自1993年以来记录的总升幅的一半。

ex.s: Snow — already threatened by a warming climate — absorbs different chemicals from the atmosphere as temperatures rise, which changes its cold-clean scent.
ex.t: 已经受到气候变暖威胁的雪，随着气温升高会从大气中吸收不同的化学物质，从而改变其清冷洁净的气味。

ex.s: a rapid rise of water surfaceB. the permafrost to melt faster
ex.t: 水面快速上升 B. 永冻层融化更快

ex.s: In just two hours, streams can rise ten to twenty feet.
ex.t: 仅仅两个小时，溪流就能上涨十到二十英尺。

ex.s: As a result it’s likely to see a rise in the size of its working-age population and to witness strong economic growth over the longer term.
ex.t: 因此从长远来看，它很可能会看到工作年龄人口的增长并见证强劲的经济增长。

ex.s: The auctioneer sees his advantage, and expatiates volubly in mingled French and English, and bids rise in rapid succession.
ex.t: 拍卖师看到自己的优势，用法语和英语混杂着滔滔不绝地说着，出价迅速接连攀升。

ex.s: That way, when the Thames rise and there is a flood in London, I’ll still be able to get to work.
ex.t: 这样，当泰晤士河涨水、伦敦发生洪水时，我仍然能去上班。

defs.def: an increase in the money you are paid for the work you do 加薪；工资增长
the act of becoming more important, successful, powerful, etc. （重要性、优势、权力等的）增强

ex.s: After becoming an important part of many British streets, the phone boxes began disappearing in the 1980s, with the rise of the mobile phone sending most of them away to the junkyards.
ex.t: 在成为英国许多街道的重要组成部分后，电话亭在20世纪80年代开始消失，随着手机的兴起，大多数电话亭被送进了垃圾场。

ex.s: Another reason for corn’s rise: The government encourages farmers to grow corn instead of rice   64   (improve) water quality.
ex.t: 玉米崛起的另一个原因：政府鼓励农民种玉米而不是水稻，以____64____（improve）改善水质。

ex.s: The price of fashion — economically and environmentally — has led to the rise of ___56___ new way of dressing, and it’s beginning to take off in Australia, too.
ex.t: 时尚的代价——无论经济上还是环境上——催生了___56___一种新的穿衣方式的兴起，而且它也开始在澳大利亚流行起来。

ex.s: Then，with ___64___ rise of science，changes began.
ex.t: 然后，随着___64___科学的兴起，变化开始了。

ex.s: The rise and fall of a city.
ex.t: 一座城市的兴衰。

ex.s: The Rise and Fall of Jazz.
ex.t: 《爵士乐的兴衰》。

ex.s: If the field of ALife manages to reproduce life’s endless “creativity” in some virtual model, those same principles could give rise to truly inventive machines.
ex.t: 如果ALife领域能够在某些虚拟模型中复制生命无限的"创造力"，那么同样的原理可能会催生真正具有创造力的机器。

ex.s: But even this dismissal suggests something：perhaps, just like life itself throughout the universe, the rise of ALife will prove unavoidable.
ex.t: 但即使是这种否定也暗示着某种东西：也许就像宇宙中的生命本身一样，ALife的兴起将是不可避免的。

ex.s: “With the rise of technology it is easy for people to make observations of different species with the aid of a mobile application,” said Barnabas Daru, who is lead author of the study and assistant professor of biology in the Stanford School of Humanities and Sciences.
ex.t: 该研究的主要作者、斯坦福人文与科学学院生物学助理教授巴纳巴斯·达鲁说：“随着科技的发展，人们很容易借助手机应用观察不同的物种。”

defs.def: an upward movement 上升
an area of land that slopes upwards 斜坡；小丘；小山
to come or go upwards; to reach a higher level or position 上升；攀升；提高；达到较高水平（或位置）

ex.s: I began practicing the violin with great passion, and rose quickly in ability.
ex.t: 我开始满怀热情地练习小提琴，能力迅速提升。

ex.s: “I remember the first time I saw a humpback whale; it just rose out of the water like some prehistoric creature and I thought it was smiling at us.
ex.t: "我记得第一次看到座头鲸；它就像某种史前生物一样从水中升起，我觉得它在对我们微笑。

ex.s: They rose in the ranks not by being friendly but by smoking cigarettes, breaking rules and playing jokes on others, among whom I soon found myself.
ex.t: 他们不是靠友善而是靠吸烟、违反规则和捉弄别人来提升地位的，我也很快成了他们中的一员。

ex.s: And when he saw the mists rising from the river and the soft clouds.
ex.t: 当他看到从河上升起的雾气和柔软的云朵时。

defs.def: to get up from a lying, sitting or kneeling position 起床；起立；站起来
when the sun, moon, etc. rises, it appears above the horizon 升起

ex.s: Then a full moon rose.
ex.t: 然后一轮满月升起了。

defs.def: to end a meeting 一群人
to increase in amount or number （数量）增加，增长，提高

ex.s: There has been a rise in the number of students applying for food courses at UK universities and colleges.
ex.t: 申请英国大学和学院食品课程的学生人数有所增加。

ex.s: There ____17____(be) a dramatic rise in the number of extreme weather events over the past 20 years,____18____(cause) largely by rising global temperatures,according to a new report from the United Nations.
ex.t: 根据联合国的一份最新报告，过去20年来极端天气事件的数量出现了____17____(be)急剧上升，____18____(cause)这在很大程度上是由全球气温升高引起的。

ex.s: Official reports suggest that the number of households with three generations living together had risen from 325,000 in 2002 to 419,000 in 2013.
ex.t: 官方报告显示，三代同堂的家庭数量从2002年的325,000户增加到2013年的419,000户。

ex.s: The average number of electronic devices rose from four per household in 1992 to 13 in 2007.
ex.t: 电子设备的平均数量从1992年的每户4台增加到了2007年的13台。

ex.s: Researchers have found that there is a direct link between the increase in food eaten outside the home and the rise in   64  (weigh) problems.
ex.t: 研究人员发现，在外面吃的食物增加与____64____（weigh）体重问题的增加之间存在直接联系。

ex.s: “Even in families whose parents didn't have a college education... families are smaller, and the idea that children need to be carefully ___53___ has really sunk in.” The ___54___ of “adult activities” could not be attributed to more homework or extracurricular activities, the study said, noting that teens today spend fewer hours on homework and the same amount of time on extracurricular as they did in the 1990s ( with the exception of community service, which has risen slightly).
ex.t: 即使在父母没有大学教育的家庭里……家庭规模变小了，孩子们需要被细心____53____（照顾）的观念也真正深入人心了。研究报告说，"成人活动"的____54____不能归因于更多的家庭作业或课外活动，并指出如今的青少年在家庭作业上花的时间更少，课外活动时间与1990年代相同（除了社区服务，其参与度略有上升）。

ex.s: It’s hard to tell exactly how many people agree with him, but research indicates that the numbers have been rising for some time.
ex.t: 很难确切地说有多少人与他意见一致，但研究表明这个数字一直在上升。

ex.s: Around 100 people have already put down a $10,000 deposit to get a Transition when they go on sale, and those numbers will likely rise after Terrafugia introduces the Transition to the public later this week at the New York Auto Show.
ex.t: 大约有100人已经支付了1万美元定金，准备在Transition上市时购买，这些数字很可能在本周晚些时候Terrafugia在纽约车展上向公众介绍Transition后还会增加。

ex.s: Around 100 people have already put down a $10,000 deposit to get a Transition when they go on sale, and those numbers will likely rise after Terrafugia introduces the Transition to the public later this week at the New York Auto Show.
ex.t: 大约有100人已经支付了1万美元定金，准备在Transition上市时购买，这些数字很可能在本周晚些时候Terrafugia在纽约车展上向公众介绍Transition后还会增加。

defs.def: to become more successful, important, powerful, etc. 变得更加成功（或重要、强大等）

ex.s: The United States rose to global power on the strength of its technology, and the lifeblood that technology has long been electricity.
ex.t: 美国凭借其技术实力崛起为全球强国，而技术长期以来的命脉是电力。

ex.s: It is encouraging to discover that by readily accepting our errors and wisely placing ourselves in the way of being wrong, we can in fact overcome weaknesses and rise stronger.
ex.t: 令人鼓舞的是，我们发现，通过坦然接受错误并明智地把自己置于可能犯错的位置，我们其实可以克服弱点，变得更强。

ex.s: “ _____50_____ , I had little confidence in the beginning,” says Ursula, “but the Sunflower Farm rose to fame and has become one of the most sought-after _____51_____ in the province.”
ex.t: "____说实话，起初我没什么信心，"乌苏拉说，"但向日葵农场声名鹊起，成为全省最热门的____景点之一。"

ex.s: When "Rise of the Planet of the Apes" was first shown to the public last month, a group of excited animal activists gathered on Hollywood Boulevard.
ex.t: 当《猩球崛起》上月首次向公映时，一群激动的动物保护者聚集在好莱坞大道上。

defs.def: if a sound rises, it becomes louder and higher 提高；增强
if the wind rises, it begins to blow more strongly 刮起来；刮得更猛
if a feeling rises inside you, it begins and gets stronger 增强
if your colour rises, your face becomes pink or red with embarrassment 脸红
if hair rises, it stands vertical instead of lying flat 竖起；立起来
to begin to fight against your ruler or government or against a foreign army 起义；反抗；奋起
to be or become visible above the surroundings 耸立；矗立；高出

ex.s: One theory behind this is that these birds have yet to change their migratory routes that take them through cities with high-rise buildings.
ex.t: 对此的一种理论是，这些鸟类尚未改变它们的迁徙路线，这些路线带它们穿过有高楼大厦的城市。

defs.def: if land rises, it slopes upwards 凸起；隆起

ex.s: The terraces are built on the slopes that rise up from the river to the top of the mountains.
ex.t: 梯田建在从河边一直上升到山顶的山坡上。

ex.s: The region rises from about 400 metres to over 3,000 metres above sea level, giving it the name the “Roof of Central China”.
ex.t: 该地区从海拔约400米上升到3000多米，因此被称为"华中屋脊"。

defs.def: a river rises where it begins to flow 起源；发源
when bread, cakes, etc. rise, they swell because of the action of yeast or baking powder 发酵
to come to life again 复活；再生
to not be affected or limited by problems, insults, etc. 克服（障碍）；超越（限制）；战胜（困难）
to be wise enough or morally good enough not to do sth wrong or not to think the same as other people 不为 … 所动；超脱
to be of a higher standard than other things of a similar kind 超群；出众；突出
to show that you are able to deal with an unexpected situation, problem, etc. 能够处理，有能力处理（突发情况、问题等）
to react when sb is deliberately trying to make you angry or get you interested in sth 上当；上钩；进圈套
